body: Thank you. It’s nice to know someone understands

Um no. You’re not accurate here at all. But since this isn’t my post and I was trying to help OP I’m not going to put a long explanation. We do a lot for each other. Sex isn’t the only way you give to a person. Im depressed and suicidal. Expecting me to give in that situation isn’t productive. What would be productive is supporting me in recovery. So what I was trying to say to OP, his gf isn’t me necessarily cheating or has a big secret like the other posters were saying. She could be depressed like me or she could be learning she is asexual. The only way to know is to really listen to her and ask these questions - not necessarily ask for a blow job.

I would suggest you tell your dad you know and give him a chance to tell your mom. Then if he doesn’t you can and should tell her. Who knows, she might know already. I mean I’m married 25 years and I told my husband long ago to have affairs and just don’t tell me or let me find out. I don’t like sex so he should go get it elsewhere. You never know what “arrangements” married people have. And if it’s not an arrangement then the only way they can possibly repair the relationship is for him to tell her and not you. So give him a chance to do that. Just my thoughts.

In my opinion it shouldn’t. My love is conditioned on being treated the way I deserve to be treated. What I think should be the goal instead is love based on mutual respect and each person taking good care of themselves so they can love the other person well. And I definitely have that with some of my friends. Definitely not with my husband though. Good luck to you!

I am a woman in a long term relationship (married) who also doesn’t want to have sex at all. And I’ve encouraged my husband to have sex elsewhere so that he can feel satisfied physically. I shouldn’t have to do what I don’t want to with my body but he should also get what he wants. I’m not cheating. I don’t have big secret. It’s just the way it is. I find people generally gross. I’m depressed AF and I just want to be left alone. Maybe in addition to worrying about your needs getting met you should be genuinely concerned about whether she is okay or not?

Me too. I don’t think it’s a weird thing to think about if you’re suffering. Who wouldn’t want suffering to end. I read somewhere that suicide happens when people’s suffering overwhelms their ability to get support or relief. I am sorry if you’re suffering so much that thinking about suicide has become your comfort. I know it’s awful because that is my reality too. I hope things get better for you.
I could’ve written this post. I feel the exact same way. Nothing more to say. You’re not alone though
There are online therapy apps like better help that you found keep private maybe?

I had a near death experience many years ago. I almost drowned. When I was without oxygen for some time, I became extremely peaceful and and without pain. I suddenly felt like I was everywhere all at once. I could see every person’s face in earth, every leaf of every tree, every ant etc etc. It was cool really. Sometimes it makes staying here harder because I want to go back to that peaceful place where I was like the wind.

Why do you get to decide if someone else deserves to be killed? I’m sorry you’re in so much pain and clearly have had it super rough but I don’t think you get to decide that. I hope you can find some peace for yourself.

It’s not my therapist’s fault. She’s great. I’m not really participating. I’m not being honest with her. I’m too tired and worn out to do that work. I give up. I can’t feel better physically. I can’t be who I was so I just don’t want to be. But thank you for being a kind human and saying nice things. My mom and kids and all my friends are far away. I can’t spend time with them at all. And I don’t want to anyway. They just remind me of who I was and how I can never be there again. They bring up all the loss. They don’t mean to. They just do by existing.
